items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I know the boy's name, he was around my age, I mean the boy was around my age, his name was Norman.

ctx.x: Well John Slaseby said something you told him that you were there when they built San Jacinto?

Oh yes, I was living right next door. In San Jacinto it was a big, it was a, you could see it had been a fine home, the house, there was some German people, I don't recall their last name, but I know the boy's name, he was around my age, I mean the boy was around my age, his name was Norman. He had an older sister by the name of Yvonne, very very pretty girl and my mama named my sister after her, named my baby sister Yvonne, right after her. And my baby sister was born in 15 and I remember that well.
Oh by the way, I keep changing the subject, do you have any brothers or anything?
